## Why visit

A distinctive traditional-drinking experience: there is no conventional public bar, and the proprietor fetches beer from a separate chilled room. With conversation instead of television or music, a small cask choice and a real-cider/perry offering, the pub feels like a modern successor to a simple beerhouse. Its remote location and early closing make it a specialist destination for aficionados rather than an easy stop between Manchester and Liverpool.

## Beer

Three changing guest cask ales on handpull and gravity, with local micros regularly represented.
